exposure: face-to-face delivery method for psychosocial intervention
phone session delivery method for psychosocial intervention
outcome: therapist preferences for intervention delivery methods
participant preferences for intervention delivery methods
barriers to engagement with intervention delivery methods
facilitators to engagement with intervention delivery methods
cohort: The participants were pregnant individuals receiving a cognitive behavioral therapy-based psychosocial intervention for prenatal anxiety and the therapists delivering the intervention.
finding: Participants generally preferred face-to-face sessions for rapport but also favored telephone sessions for easy scheduling, ultimately preferring a mix of both methods to combine benefits and address challenges.
